_help.site_name: Required. Client site/building name — stamped on every report and alert.
_help.client: Optional. Legal client name for the deliverable + invoice trail.
_help.technician: Optional. Who set the agent up. Defaults to Ark Web Solutions.
_help.authorized: Optional. Free-text note of the signed authorization, logged each run. --authorized on the command line overrides it.
_help.watch: List of things to check for reachability. Each entry is one of: {"url": "https://..."} (HTTP GET, up = status < 400 or 401/403); {"host": "1.2.3.4", "port": 3389} (TCP connect); or {"host": "1.2.3.4"} (ping). Add "name" for a friendly label. HTTPS with a self-signed/internal cert (NAS, router, camera, iDRAC/ESXi) is reported as WARN 'up but cert untrusted', not a false outage — use the TCP-port form for a simple up/down check, or add "insecure": true to a url entry to skip cert verification.
_help.disks: List of local paths to check free space. min_free_pct = PROBLEM below this, warn_free_pct = WARN below this. Use the machine THIS agent runs on (C:\, D:\ on Windows; / or /mnt/... on Linux).
_help.backups: List of expected backup files/dirs. If a dir, the newest file inside is used. max_age_hours = PROBLEM when older (backup didn't run). Optional min_size_bytes = WARN if the newest backup is smaller than expected.
_help.checks: Best-effort Windows posture checks. windows_firewall and pending_reboot are automatically skipped (not failed) on non-Windows hosts.
_help.reporting: How alerts go out. SECRETS come from env vars: set ntfy_topic_env / webhook_url_env to the NAME of an environment variable holding the secret (preferred so it never lands on disk). You may instead put ntfy_topic / webhook_url directly here, but the agent will warn you. alert_on: 'problem' (default), 'warn' (also alert on warnings), or 'always' (heartbeat — send every run, useful as a dead-man's switch).
_help.timeouts: http_timeout / tcp_timeout / ping_timeout are optional seconds-per-check overrides.
